assay_run.method: LC-MS/MS comparison aggregate for the nine labelled differentiated SH-SY5Y preparations, three per treatment. Samples were analyzed in technical triplicate and processed using Proteome Discoverer 2.5.0.400. Individual acquisition identities and links are unreported.
assay_run.platform: RSLCnano MS system coupled to Orbitrap Exploris 480
